user.title: MiWiFi Router
user.description:
Set up the Xiaomi MiWiFi Router integration.

ℹ️ Speed/traffic units are display units and can be changed at any time: entities are never re-created and history is never lost.

data.force_hash_algo: Password hash algorithm (Auto-detect is recommended; manually specify only if login fails)
data.speed_unit: Realtime speed sensor display unit (Auto = readable unit picked from the value)
data.total_unit: Total traffic sensor display unit (Auto = readable unit picked from the value)
data.unit_mode: Unit family (Byte: B/s, MB/s, GB... / Bit: bit/s, Mbit/s, Gbit...)

devices.title: Select devices to add sensors for
devices.description: Create independent speed and traffic sensors for selected devices. You can skip this and configure later.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong password or hash algorithm mismatch (try manually specifying SHA1/SHA256)

init.title: MiWiFi Router Options
init.description:
Adjust polling intervals and select devices to add sensors for. Unchecked devices will have their sensors automatically removed after reload.

ℹ️ Speed/traffic units are display units: changing them never re-creates entities and never loses history or long-term statistics.

data.force_hash_algo: Password hash algorithm (Auto-detect is recommended; manually specify only if login fails)
data.speed_unit: Realtime speed sensor display unit (display only; changing it keeps history)
data.total_unit: Total traffic sensor display unit (display only; changing it keeps history)
data.unit_mode: Unit family (Byte: B/s, MB/s, GB... / Bit: bit/s, Mbit/s, Gbit...)
